instruction: Repair pointer.resolve(document, pointer) for JSON values. Empty pointer returns the document; otherwise pointer starts / and slash-separated tokens unescape ~1 to / and ~0 to ~ in that order. Any other ~ escape raises ValueError. Dictionary keys are literal strings, including numeric and empty keys. Lists require a canonical nonnegative ASCII decimal index (0 or no leading zero), with invalid spelling raising ValueError and out-of-range raising IndexError. Missing dictionary keys raise KeyError; scalar traversal raises ValueError. Preserve document.
